key_insight: The paper establishes almost sure boundedness of SGD iterates and convergence to the set of critical points for deep linear networks under mild conditions.
engineering_relevance: The results strengthen the theoretical basis for stochastic training in non-convex linear network models with deterministic or adaptive step sizes.
method: Analyze SGD for deep linear networks with regularized squared loss.
Establish almost sure boundedness of the iterates.
Use asymptotic pseudotrajectory theory to prove convergence without relying on Lipschitz properties or whitened data.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical convergence guarantees but describes no datasets, experiments, or empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: Convergence to the set of critical points does not guarantee a global optimum, and the results concern linear rather than nonlinear networks.
paper_title: Convergence of stochastic gradient descent for learning linear neural networks
